deadline.value: International applicants for September 2027 must apply by February 28, 2027 (domestic: July 31, 2027).

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: You do not need a supervisor to apply, but you must be accepted for supervision by a department member to be admitted.
supervisor.quote: must also be accepted for supervision by a member of the Department

also.quote: You do not need to find a supervisor

funding.value: Engineering guarantees full-time domestic and international PhD students at least CAD 21,000 plus tuition a year, usually for up to four years.
funding.quote: The Faculty of Engineering has a minimum funding package for full-time domestic and international Doctoral students | This minimum amount is $21,000 plus tuition

entry_route.value: A master's (MASc, MSc or equivalent) in a related field is required; bachelor's holders normally start in the MASc.
entry_route.quote: Master's Degree (MAsc, MSc, or equivalent) in a related field.

gre_general.value: McMaster Engineering does not require GRE scores.
gre_general.quote: No. McMaster Engineering does not require a GRE score.

toefl_min.value: The Faculty of Engineering requires TOEFL iBT 88 with at least 20 per band.
toefl_min.quote: Faculty of Engineering a minimum score of 88 (internet-based, iBT or iBT Home Edition); minimum of 20 per band.

english_waiver.value: Engineering exempts applicants whose university degree was taught in English from the English test.
english_waiver.quote: Applicants who have completed a university degree where the official language of instruction is English, do not need to submit a language proficiency test.

notes: The department page still lists a $110 application fee; the School of Graduate Studies lists $150.
